mclink.title: 🔗 Link your Minecraft account
mclink.instructions:
1. Join **{address}**
2. Type in chat: `/discord link {code}`

The code expires {expires}. Do not share it.

mclink.token:
Your plugin token (shown only once – keep it secret!):
```
{token}
```
Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to the bridge on port {port}. See docs/minecraft-integration.md.
